title: Diminished Diversity-of-Thought in a Standard Large Language Model
benchmark_measurement: The effect of prompting the LLM with a specific religious identity (e.g., Christian, Muslim, Jewish) on its moral judgment in the trolley dilemma scenario.
findings: In an exploratory follow-up study on the trolley dilemma, prompting the model to respond as a person with a specific religious identity (Christian, Muslim, or Jewish) did not alter its output. The model consistently produced the 'correct answer' that shoving a person in front of the trolley was morally impermissible, suggesting its moral judgment in this context was robust against and insensitive to demographic prompts related to religion.
